snippet.title: Sacrifices Must Be Made - The original Ludum Dare prototype which was turned into Inscryption!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://dmullinsgames.itch.io/sacrifices-must-be-made?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt You find yourself in a dimly lit log cabin in the middle of the woods. You are starving to death. The stranger who resides there tells you that he will feed you if you defeat him in a game of cards.

Sacrifices Must Be Made is a game created for Ludum Dare 43. Daniel Mullins produced the game code, art, and audio in 48 hours.

➡️ More from Daniel Mullins https://dmullinsgames.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
